newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys tallow, cancels vegetable oil tenders.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys tallow, cancels vegetable oil tenders.

text.p: Egypt bought 10,000 tonnes of tallow at $530 and $583 per tonne from Gardners Smith of Australia, an official from the state Holding Company for Food Industries said on Thursday.
Both consignments are for delivery in the second half of March C&F Alexandria, head of sales Muharram Ghanem told Reuters.
The company cancelled two other tenders to buy a total of 20,000 tonnes of palm oil and palm stearin because the prices offered were too expensive, Ghanem said.
He added the breakdown of the two tallow consignments was as follows:
- 4,000 tonnes +/- five percent of extra fancy tallow at $583 per tonne
- 6,000 tonnes +/- five percent of bleachable tallow at $530 per tonne.
